presets.name: MUS 01 Pocket Sub
presets.purpose: OSC 1 alone, triangle, 32': low-frequency shape and tuning.
presets.listen: The main hook sounds at F2/Ab2/C3; the closing keys F3 and F2 sound F1 and F0 on 32'. The final low note is a deliberate range probe, after an audible bass line. Listen to triangle purity and the difference between a rounded gate and a note gap.
presets.musical_intent: Syncopated F-minor bass, ending with a two-octave sub drop.

presets.name: MUS 02 Tooth Groove
presets.purpose: OSC 2 alone, 16' shark tooth: waveform colour in a D-Dorian groove.
presets.listen: OSC 2 alone at 16' gives this line a woody asymmetric edge. Hear repeated D attacks, the B-natural turn, and the return home; the pitch centre stays exposed without detuning or modulation.
presets.musical_intent: A D-Dorian bass hook: the natural sixth lifts the second half.

presets.name: MUS 03 Reverse Reply
presets.purpose: OSC 3 alone, reverse saw, 8', keyboard control on.
presets.listen: OSC 3's reverse saw carries the hook with CONTROL on. Compare its harmonic balance and attack to an ordinary saw; polarity is a waveform check rather than a promise of a radically different sound.
presets.musical_intent: A G-minor call and response, with a high answer and a low cadence.

presets.name: MUS 04 Arcade Lead
presets.purpose: OSC 1 alone, square, 4': octave-up oscillator tracking.
presets.listen: The 4' square sounds an octave above the played keys: this melody reaches sounding C6. Listen for hollow odd harmonics and the clean separation between the short pickups and longer answer.
presets.musical_intent: A climbing C-minor pickup answers with a falling line and a high final C.

presets.name: MUS 05 Glass Pulse
presets.purpose: OSC 2 alone, wide pulse, 2': two-octave shift and upper-register harmonics.
presets.listen: The 2' wide pulse uses input notes an octave below 04 to reach the same sounding melody. The rhythm is identical, making its brighter pulse-width colour easy to compare with the square while preserving the separate-oscillator test.
presets.musical_intent: The same lead melody as 04, at the same nominal sounding pitches.

presets.name: MUS 06 Top Shelf
presets.purpose: OSC 3 alone, narrow pulse, 8': high keyboard register.
presets.listen: F5 through C6 is the top of the original keyboard. The narrow pulse should remain recognisably nasal across the run; the held final F gives time to hear pitch stability after the fast high notes.
presets.musical_intent: A high F-major hook with a quick flourish and a longer resolving note.

presets.name: MUS 07 Sweep Groove
presets.purpose: Full-range low-pass sweep with EMPHASIS 0; two 8' saws ten cents apart.
presets.listen: Four seconds opening, a one-second tonic hold fully open, then the same four-second riff closing. Repeating the pitches and rhythm makes the change in brightness audible without replacing it with a scale exercise. EMPHASIS 0 gives a gentle opening; the held A3 at the top exposes the ten-cent saw beating. Use a tuner/beat-rate match for the between-line detune setting.
presets.hardware: Turn only CUTOFF from -5 to +5 and back using the timed points. Both keyboard-tracking switches are OFF so note changes do not add a cutoff sweep. Contour amount and filter modulation stay at 0. The MIDI does not turn the physical knob.
presets.musical_intent: The same syncopated minor-pentatonic riff opens and closes with the filter.

presets.name: MUS 08 Octave Bounce
presets.purpose: OSC 1 + 3, a 16' triangle over a 32' square.
presets.listen: The 16' triangle sits over the 32' square. Short repeated roots expose their blend; octave leaps show that the two layers keep their ratio. Two-thirds filter tracking changes colour across the line.
presets.musical_intent: A buoyant F-minor bass that hops up, then falls back to the sub.

presets.name: MUS 09 Parallel Fifths
presets.purpose: OSC 2 + 3, 8' triangle and saw; OSC 3 seven semitones higher.
presets.listen: OSC 2 triangle and OSC 3 saw play a parallel fifth inside one voice. This gives a harmonised sound while MIDI remains monophonic. Tune the true +7-semitone interval on the hardware before the take.
presets.musical_intent: An open-fifth C-minor hook with a lifted octave answer.

presets.name: MUS 10 Resonant Run
presets.purpose: Full-range low-pass sweep with EMPHASIS 8; three 32'/16'/8' octave layers.
presets.listen: Four seconds opening, a one-second tonic hold fully open, then the same four-second riff closing. Repeating the pitches and rhythm makes the change in brightness audible without replacing it with a scale exercise. EMPHASIS 8 gives the riff a travelling resonant bite. Input F3 voices F1/F2/F3 in the three oscillators.
presets.hardware: Turn only CUTOFF from -5 to +5 and back using the timed points. Both keyboard-tracking switches are OFF so note changes do not add a cutoff sweep. Contour amount and filter modulation stay at 0. The MIDI does not turn the physical knob.
presets.musical_intent: The same syncopated minor-pentatonic riff opens and closes with the filter.

presets.name: MUS 11 Rubber Bass
presets.purpose: Low-pass filter contour and zero loudness sustain: a short two-saw bass.
presets.listen: The short filter contour gives every attack a rubbery vowel; sustain zero keeps the final long key from becoming a held organ tone. A mixture of short gates and rests exposes decay and re-arming.
presets.musical_intent: A clipped, syncopated F-minor bass with a chromatic turnaround.

presets.name: MUS 12 Slow Reply
presets.purpose: Independent filter/loudness attack in a three-note swell phrase.
presets.listen: Longer gates let the loudness rise before the filter finishes opening. The falling final interval makes the swell feel like a phrase; the remaining tail exposes both decay contours.
presets.musical_intent: A three-note C–G–F answer whose swells overlap in colour, inside a mono voice.

presets.name: MUS 13 White Lotus
presets.purpose: The unchanged factory White Lotus: narrow-pulse bass, a third-harmonic filter ring and OSC 3 LO filter modulation.
presets.listen: The longer C3/C4 gates expose the roughly 11 Hz filter motion and third-harmonic ring; the short connecting notes turn it into a hook. Every saved factory setting remains exact, including its fine positions and output volume.
presets.hardware: Set OSC 1 to 8' narrow pulse, mixer 10; all other mixer sources OFF. Use LO filter, cutoff -2.14, emphasis 7, both tracking switches ON, contour amount 0. OSC 3 is a triangle at LO, CONTROL OFF and mixer OFF; tune its rate to approximately 11 Hz. FILTER MODULATION ON, OSCILLATOR MODULATION OFF, MOD MIX 0. Before recording, send CC 1 = 0 to clear incoming MIDI modulation, then load White Lotus on CA-72 and move the hardware MOD DEPTH knob to match its excursion. A MIDI wheel message takes over the hardware depth until that knob moves, so complete resets before setting the hardware knob. The shared clip sends no CC 1; leave the modulation controller untouched during the take, preserving the CA-72 preset's exact 0.17 and the matched hardware knob depth.
presets.musical_intent: An original C-minor pentatonic hook with a higher call and a low answer.

presets.name: MUS 14 Ladder Melody
presets.purpose: Filter self-oscillation, no VCO in the mixer, full keyboard tracking.
presets.listen: All VCO mixer switches are off: the ladder itself supplies the pitched tone. Full tracking makes the relative melody possible. Printed cutoff -2 is not a concert-pitch promise; tune once before an optional pitch-matched pass, never between notes.
presets.musical_intent: A soft F-major call and a two-octave whistle answer.

presets.name: MUS 15 High Pass Funk
presets.purpose: High-pass filter, resonance, contour, two-thirds keyboard tracking.
presets.listen: The only HI patch keeps the riff's upper harmonics while thinning its bottom. Play the same pattern in LO for the controlled mode comparison; the wide pulse/reverse-saw combination and two-thirds tracking stay fixed.
presets.musical_intent: A wiry F-minor funk line with a high-register reply.

presets.name: MUS 16 Sliding Hook
presets.purpose: GLIDE with a continuous monophonic phrase and single triggering.
presets.listen: Zero-gap joins keep exactly one key at a time. GLIDE 4 lets the motif move rather than lingering on every transition. The wide jump and falling answer expose glide distance and direction; repeat with glide off, hardware multi-trigger off.
presets.musical_intent: A joined C-minor hook with small scoops and a wide octave slide.

presets.name: MUS 17 Noise Break
presets.purpose: White noise through fast contours: percussion without oscillators.
presets.listen: Pitch and velocity do not accent this noise patch. The groove comes from timing and gate length. Shorter decays expose fast transient behaviour; change only WHITE to PINK on a repeat for a colour comparison.
presets.musical_intent: A two-bar noise break with offbeat doubles and a spaced closing hit.

presets.name: MUS 18 Pink Flute
presets.purpose: Pink noise excites tracking resonance: a breathy filter melody.
presets.listen: Pink noise excites a strong tracking resonance; there is no audible oscillator. The keys move the filter's spectral focus. Hear a breathier, noisier contour than the self-oscillating ladder in 14, rather than treating this as a perfectly tuned flute.
presets.musical_intent: A breathy resonant-filter melody, with an octave reply.

presets.name: MUS 19 Wavering Lead
presets.purpose: OSC 3 as an untracked LO triangle LFO, pitch destination only.
presets.listen: The held ends expose the LO triangle's smooth pitch modulation; shorter middle notes give it a melodic purpose. OSC 3 CONTROL and its mixer stay off, so the LFO rate does not follow this melody.
presets.hardware: Select OSC 3 as source, NOISE/MOD SRC rather than the separate LFO, MOD MIX fully to OSC 3, MOD DEPTH 10. Use CC 1 = 6 as a reproducible starting depth, then match measured pitch excursion.
presets.musical_intent: A singing C-minor line, framed by two longer vibrato notes.

presets.name: MUS 20 Filter Ostinato
presets.purpose: OSC 3 as an untracked LO reverse-saw LFO, filter destination only.
presets.listen: OSC 3's LO reverse saw moves only the filter. The repeating note rhythm lets its asymmetric fall/reset drift across the groove; it is free-running, not DAW-synchronised. Compare another take changing only the LFO shape.
presets.hardware: Select OSC 3 and NOISE/MOD SRC, MOD DEPTH 10, CC 1 = 26. Match rate and cutoff excursion by measurement; the MIDI wheel transfer curve is not guaranteed identical on another hardware unit.
presets.musical_intent: A clipped F-minor ostinato that plays against the free-running filter rhythm.

presets.name: MUS 21 Metal Arpeggio
presets.purpose: Keyboard-tracked OSC 3 at audio rate modulates oscillator pitch.
presets.listen: The bright metallic sidebands follow the melody because OSC 3 CONTROL is on. OSC 3 remains out of the mixer: its contribution is audio-rate exponential FM, without ring modulation or oscillator sync.
presets.hardware: Select OSC 3/NOISE sources, MOD DEPTH 10 and CC 1 = 13; keep OSC 3 mixer OFF and OSC 3 CONTROL ON. Match modulation depth before comparing sidebands.
presets.musical_intent: A C-minor-nine arpeggio with a displaced answer and an octave landing.

presets.name: MUS 22 Broken Square
presets.purpose: Midpoint MOD MIX: LO square OSC 3 plus noise, both destinations.
presets.listen: LO square motion and modulation noise roughen the pitch and cutoff together. The repeated D motif lets you hear the random variation against a stable gesture. The mixer noise remains off; compare MOD MIX 0/5/10 on separate takes.
presets.hardware: Select OSC 3 and NOISE/MOD SRC, MOD MIX 5, MOD DEPTH 10, CC 1 = 13. Use the built-in noise source with no cable in MOD SOURCE; match depth, then compare distributions rather than individual noise samples.
presets.musical_intent: A lurching D-minor riff with a flattened-fifth passing note.

presets.name: MUS 23 External Rhythm
presets.purpose: External audio through preamp, low-pass filter and keyboard-gated contours.
presets.listen: The source stays at 220 Hz; the MIDI keys alter filter tracking and gating rather than the source's pitch. Follow the same external probe on both devices, with all VCO/noise mixer switches off and feedback zero.
presets.hardware: Connect the supplied mono test signal to EXT IN, which breaks the hardware's automatic output return. The plug-in receives that same file on its side chain. Match input voltage; an interface's dBFS is not an analog voltage.
presets.musical_intent: A rhythmic vowel-like phrase made by gating and filtering the external source.

presets.name: MUS 24 Feedback Stomp
presets.purpose: External-input feedback and mixer overload from the hardware-accessible loop.
presets.listen: The PHONES return gives the phrase a thicker nonlinear edge, with DRIVE still zero. Short attacks versus the held closing root expose the mixer/preamp's behaviour. Match listening gain on a return-off repeat; a louder take alone is not the distortion test.
presets.hardware: For the closest topology, patch one PHONES output channel into EXT IN and use the independent PHONES volume; start at its 6 mark and EXT IN 6. CA-72 FEEDBACK 6 is a starting setting, not a promise of equal loop gain. The normalled uncabled return also works but depends on MAIN VOLUME; record which route and measured return level you used.
presets.musical_intent: An overdriven F-minor stomp, with a descending chromatic turnaround.
